description: D-064 (c): the values written in two or more census areas that are not yet in the common catalog (a catalog entry of the census, scripts/census add --catalog), each with a documented reason. scripts/structure-check fails on a value of 2+ areas that is not here, and on an entry the base branch does not have: the list only shrinks. An entry that no longer spans 2+ areas is a warning; integration drops it. The bare 0, 1, true and "" are the remainder domain and are not listed. OU-DECOUPLE F5 (D-113): every value listed was the deleted product's, so the list is empty.

reasons.several-meanings: Written in 3+ areas with more than one meaning (an entity kind, a field name, a status, a separator, a short token); the common-catalog pass (PR #481) left it out until each meaning gets its own key.
reasons.number-per-area: A number whose meaning differs per area (a limit, a size, a timeout, a position); each meaning moves to its own key, the common one when the meaning is shared.
reasons.remainder: The boolean false, deferred with the bare 0, 1 and true to the remainder domain (D-050, D-063).
reasons.two-areas: Written in exactly two areas before D-064; triage pending in step 6 (one meaning goes to the common catalog, several meanings get one key each).
